commentary.text: 90+6' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' A substitution has been made. Jon Moncayola is replaced by Arnaiz Jose Manuel (Osasuna).
90' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Lucas Torro will be replaced by Iker Munoz (Osasuna).
89' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
88' 10:11 – the total goal attempt statistics.
84' A corner kick by Celta Vigo is thwarted by the well prepared Sergio Herrera (Osasuna).
82' The referee allows time for a substitution. Iago Aspas will be replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
81' Rafael Benitez has decided to make a change. Luca de la Torre (Celta Vigo) replaces Hugo Sotelo.
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Franco Cervi leaves the pitch and Manu Sanchez (Celta Vigo) comes on.
79' Here comes a substitution. Jesus Areso (Osasuna) is brought on as a substitute for Aimar Oroz.
79' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to substitute Ante Budimir and he is replaced by Chimy Avila (Osasuna).
74' 0 - 2 Goal! Moi Gomez (Osasuna) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low inside the left post. It's 0:2.
74' Off the post! Ruben Pena (Osasuna) amazingly found his way through the defence, but lacked a precise finish as his effort from close range bounced off the right post.
73' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Gabri Veiga (Celta Vigo) is coming onto the pitch as Jorgen Strand Larsen cannot continue after picking up an injury.
67' Jagoba Arrasate has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) replacing Ruben Garcia.
65' That was close. Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) fires a shot from the edge of the box which goes a whisker wide of the right post.
64' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) wastes a big opportunity! He controls the ball after a nice low pass and shoots from a promising distance. His poor effort goes miles wide of the right post.
63' We are about to witness a substitution. Miguel Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) is replacing Carles Perez.
63' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
61' The ball is out of play and Osasuna manage to earn a corner.
60' The referee blows his whistle as Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) was too aggressive in his challenge.
58' Corner kick. Celta Vigo will have an opportunity.
58' Celta Vigo control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
56' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 8:8.
51' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) has tested the patience of referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
49' Celta Vigo have a corner.
48' PENALTY APPEAL by Celta Vigo, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
48' Franco Cervi (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
46' The attendance for today's match is 20269.
46' Referee Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+3' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) is ready on the edge of the six-yard box and duly receives the cross, but his header fizzes just wide of the left post.
45+2' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot.
45+1' Johan Mojica (Osasuna) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Looks like Johan Mojica (Osasuna) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
41' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Celta Vigo) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
41' Total attempts – 4:6.
38' One of the players from Celta Vigo times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
36' The corner is bent into the box and met with a firm header by Alejandro Catena (Osasuna), but it's just wide of the left post.
36' There's an opportunity for Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
35' Dangerous play by Carles Perez (Celta Vigo). Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes blows his whistle for a foul.
34' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
31' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) hits a dangerous effort towards the roof of the net from the promising free kick. His shot is stopped by a well prepared Ivan Villar.
30' Unai Nunez (Celta Vigo) is yellow-carded.
29' Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
26' Carles Perez (Celta Vigo) is caught offside!
24' 0 - 1 Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) gets to a rebound inside the six-yard box and produces a header. He manages to put the ball into the bottom left corner, and thus alter the score to 0:1.

24' What a chance! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) jumps and powers a precise header towards the roof of the net. The goalkeeper makes a spectacular reflex save and the ball deflects off his gloves onto the crossbar.
23' Ruben Pena (Osasuna) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
19' Osasuna enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
15' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
13' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Celta Vigo.
13' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked.
11' Good work from Celta Vigo as they win a corner.
10' Osasuna are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
9' Osasuna will look to benefit from a promising free kick near the touchline.
6' Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) climbs highest in the box and sends a poor header miles over the crossbar. Very poor attempt.
5' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) receives a lofted pass from the side and shoots from around the penalty spot, but the ball flies onto the right post!
5' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Celta Vigo was in an offside position.
3' The resulting set piece from Celta Vigo is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

2' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) is thwarted and cleared to safety. Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Celta Vigo will have the kick-off.
Pablo Gonzalez Fuertes got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
